sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: Use this guide when a relationship, friendship, brief encounter, or former partner feels hard to forget. The goal is to explain intensity and pattern recognition, not to decide whether the user should contact, keep, leave, or wait for another person.

sections.heading: Core Guardrail
sections.body: No single contact decides the relationship. One or two aspects can describe force, familiarity, longing, or friction, but they do not prove compatibility, destiny, permanence, or obligation. Read the whole chart comparison, the maturity of both people, and the real-world behavior.

sections.heading: Saturn Glue
sections.body: When one person's Saturn contacts the other's Sun, Moon, Venus, Mars, or lunar nodes, the bond can feel weighty, consequential, and difficult to dismiss. Saturn can show loyalty, endurance, commitment, and shared responsibility. Under stress, it can feel like pressure, guilt, fear, obligation, or a connection that stays because it is heavy rather than healthy.

items.label: Constructive Use
items.body: Name what the connection asks each person to build, repair, commit to, or take seriously.

items.label: Caution
items.body: Do not romanticize heaviness. A sticky Saturn bond can be deep, but it can also be a cage if control, fear, or one-sided responsibility is present.

sections.heading: South Node Familiarity
sections.body: When someone's Sun, Moon, Venus, or personal planet lands on the other person's South Node, the connection can feel instantly familiar. The pull is often toward what is known, comfortable, rehearsed, or easy to slip back into. Familiarity is not the same as growth.

sections.heading: North Node Growth
sections.body: North Node contacts can feel less comfortable but more developmental. The person may activate a future-facing version of the user: new choices, new courage, new standards, and a stretch beyond the old pattern. Frame North Node contact as invitation, not guarantee.

sections.heading: Dreaming And The Unconscious
sections.body: Dreams, preoccupation, and a sense of carrying someone in the background often point to 12th-house overlays, Neptune contacts, or Black Moon Lilith contacts. The person may live in the user's unconscious longer than the actual encounter justifies.

sections.heading: 12th-House Overlays
sections.body: When one person's planets fall in the other's 12th house, the connection can operate under the surface. The user may feel affected without knowing why. This overlay can describe compassion, spiritual sensitivity, projection, secrecy, avoidance, or a bond that is easier to feel than explain.

sections.heading: Neptune Idealization
sections.body: Neptune contacts can dissolve the boundary between the real person and the imagined person. They can bring tenderness, inspiration, spiritual resonance, and creative longing. They can also create fantasy, projection, excuses, or attachment to potential rather than behavior.

sections.heading: Black Moon Lilith Magnetism
sections.body: Black Moon Lilith contacts can feel charged, exposed, taboo, or difficult to control. They may show where desire, shame, refusal, projection, or buried instinct gets activated. Keep this interpretation optional and secondary, especially in mainstream relationship views.

sections.heading: Pluto Bonds
sections.body: Pluto contacts can create intense attachment, obsession, jealousy, compulsion, and the feeling that another person has changed the user's internal landscape. Constructively, Pluto shows transformation and honesty about power. Unconsciously, it can keep a person circling pain and calling it depth.

sections.heading: Vertex And Juno
sections.body: Vertex contacts can make brief meetings feel unusually significant, especially when a personal planet or node is involved. Juno contacts can add a commitment-flavored recognition. Treat both as signals of charge or theme, not proof of duration.

sections.heading: Non-Romantic Bonds
sections.body: This framework applies to friendships, siblings, mentors, collaborators, and brief strangers as well as romance. Saturn describes time and duty. Pluto describes transformation. Neptune describes inspiration or illusion. Nodal contacts describe familiarity and growth direction.

sections.heading: Agency
sections.body: The chart can explain why a connection is hard to forget. It does not create a debt, command a reunion, or require waiting. Insight is useful when it returns choice to the user. If the analysis becomes a way to keep orbiting the person, the app should redirect toward grounding, support, and present-tense decisions.

sections.heading: Safety
sections.body: If the connection involves control, fear, coercion, surveillance, isolation, or harm, do not explain the pull as romance or spiritual significance. Lead with safety and real-world support. Astrology never rationalizes harm.
